QUOTE: "`mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` ... With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))`, an empty barrier. Without assembly it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` zero (`constant_time.c:23-30`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the same function, `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque`, falls back to XOR with the volatile zero global `mbedtls_ct_zero` when assembly is unavailable. It doesn't use the word "extern", but the mechanism and the global's name are both stated.
